technical_and_design_decisions: Extend existing Apache Ambari plugin to support Spring XD on YARN, ensuring compatibility with current deployment models.
Implement upgrade functionality for Spring XD from 1.2 RC to 1.2 GA via Ambari plugin with backward compatibility checks.
Modify Hadoop connector configuration to support local file system through fsUri = file:// for single-node setups.
Add configuration option for Sqoop jobs to accept system properties via job execution parameters.
Integrate spring-cloud-config server with spring-bus modules using Spring Cloud libraries for centralized property management.
Use profiling tools and load testing frameworks for channel performance investigation in SI 4.2.
Establish serialization benchmarks with representative data sets to measure baseline characteristics in XD.
Conduct code and design reviews focusing on foundation gaps in spring-bus architecture.
assumptions: The developer has access to the existing Spring XD codebase, version control, and development environment.
Standard development tools (e.g., Maven, Git, IDE) and testing frameworks are available and configured.
The software increment is limited to Spring XD modules and does not require changes to core Spring Framework.
Testing environments (e.g., YARN cluster, Hadoop instances) are accessible or can be simulated with minimal additional setup.
A workday is defined as 8 hours of focused development work, including coding, testing, and documentation tasks.
Effort estimates account for typical debugging and iteration cycles during implementation.

activities.activity_description: Gather, analyze, and prioritize user stories U1-U8 to define detailed development tasks and acceptance criteria.
Design integration with Apache Ambari for Spring XD on YARN and plan upgrade path from 1.2 RC to GA, including compatibility considerations.
Develop code and configuration changes to add Ambari installed Spring XD on YARN option, ensuring cluster setup functionality.
Create upgrade scripts or documentation for using Ambari plugin to upgrade Spring XD from 1.2 RC to 1.2 GA.

activities.activity_description: Modify HDFS connector code to support Hadoop LocalFileSystem via fsUri = file:// for local data loading scenarios.
Implement option to specify and pass system properties to Sqoop jobs running in separate Java processes.
Configure and integrate spring-cloud-config server with spring-bus modules for centralized external property management.
Set up performance tests, run simulations, and analyze results to identify bottlenecks in SI 4.2 channel performance.
Create benchmarks and measure serialization characteristics in XD to establish performance baselines.
Review current architecture and design specifications for spring-bus to identify and document foundation-level gaps.
Perform unit, integration, and performance testing for all implemented features and fixes to ensure quality.
Update technical documentation, user guides, and prepare deployment artifacts for the software increment.
